odvs.description: win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_aggressiveness ia the policy setting configures how aggressively Remote Encryption Prevention Protection blocks malicious IP addresses. The recommended state for this setting is: Enabled: Medium or higher. Configuring this setting to High also conforms to the benchmark. 1 = Medium, 2 = High
odvs.name: remote_encryption_protection_aggressiveness

registry.path: SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Remediation\Behavioral Network Blocks\Remote Encryption Protection

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "18.10.43.11.1.2.1 | PATCH | Ensure Configure how aggressively Remote Encryption Protection blocks threats is set to Enabled: Medium or higher"
  when: win25cis_rule_18_10_43_11_1_2_1
  tags:
    - level2-domaincontroller
    - level2-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_18.10.43.11.1.2.1
    - patch
    - defender
    - brute_force
    - remote_encryption
    - NIST800-171_3.14.1
    - NIST800-171_3.14.5
    - NIST800-171_3.14.6
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-7
    - NIST800-53R5_SI-4
  block:
    - name: "18.10.43.11.1.2.1 | PATCH | Ensure Configure how aggressively Remote Encryption Protection blocks threats is set to Enabled: Medium or higher | Set Registry Value"
      when:
        - win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_aggressiveness == 1 or
          win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_aggressiveness == 2
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Remediation\Behavioral Network Blocks\Remote Encryption Protection
        name: RemoteEncryptionProtectionAggressiveness
        data: "{{ win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_aggressiveness }}"
        type: dword

    - name: "18.10.43.11.1.2.1 | AUDIT | Ensure Configure how aggressively Remote Encryption Protection blocks threats is set to Enabled: Medium or higher | Warning Message"
      when:
        - win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_aggressiveness != 1
        - win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_aggressiveness != 2
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid setting for win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_aggressiveness. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "18.10.43.11.1.2.1 | AUDIT | Ensure Configure how aggressively Remote Encryption Protection blocks threats is set to Enabled: Medium or higher | Warn Count"
      when:
        - win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_aggressiveness != 1
        - win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_aggressiveness != 2
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '18.10.43.11.1.2.1'
